data.text/markdown:
pyversions

A Python module to get versions of imported modules in current session. https://github.com/demotu/pyversions

Installation

pip install pyversions
Or 
conda install -c duartexyz pyversions
To run this marimo notebook in an isolated environment with all its dependencies: 
uvx marimo edit --sandbox pyversions_notebook.py

Examples

Call versions() after all modules are imported; it prints information about the environment and the versions of the imported modules, and returns the same information as a list:

console.name: stdout
console.text:
Linux 7.0.0-38-generic 64-bit #38-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri Sep  4 09:10:14 UTC 2026
CPython 3.14.7 (main, Aug 14 2026, 15:35:28) [Clang 22.1.3 ]
Oct 20 2026, 22:40:33

Module            Version
marimo             0.25.2
matplotlib         3.11.2
numpy               2.5.4
scipy              1.18.1

data.text/markdown: The returned list has the operating system, the Python version, the date, and the name and version of each module:

data.application/json: ["Linux 7.0.0-38-generic 64-bit #38-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri Sep  4 09:10:14 UTC 2026", "CPython 3.14.7 (main, Aug 14 2026, 15:35:28) [Clang 22.1.3 ]", "Oct 20 2026, 22:40:33", ["marimo", "0.25.2"], ["matplotlib", "3.11.2"], ["numpy", "2.5.4"], ["scipy", "1.18.1"]]

data.text/markdown: Pass a dictionary of names and modules (for example, globals()) to get the versions of other modules, and set show=False to not print:

data.application/json: ["Linux 7.0.0-38-generic 64-bit #38-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri Sep  4 09:10:14 UTC 2026", "CPython 3.14.7 (main, Aug 14 2026, 15:35:28) [Clang 22.1.3 ]", "Oct 20 2026, 22:40:34", ["numpy", "2.5.4"]]
